meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Colombia (unitary national jurisdiction; no sub-state company registers)
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Civil Law (codified; commercial matters governed by Código de Comercio and S.A.S. statutory regime under Law 1258 of 2008)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: United States-Colombia Trade Promotion Agreement (in force May 2012, includes investment chapter)
Canada-Colombia Free Trade Agreement (in force August 2011)
Colombia-European Union Trade Agreement (provisionally applied since August 2013)
Pacific Alliance Framework Agreement with Chile, Mexico and Peru
Colombia-United Kingdom Continuity Trade and Investment Agreement

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Law 1258 of 2008 (S.A.S. regime, arts. 3-5, 20, 46); Código de Comercio arts. 71-81, 169-181 (name and registry); Law 526 of 1999, amended by Law 1621 of 2013 (UIAF and intelligence); Law 1121 of 2006 (CFT); Law 2195 of 2022 (integrity, AML and corruption); DIAN Resolution 000164 of 2021, extended by DIAN Resolutions 000107 of 2022 and 000099 of 2023 (Registro Único de Beneficiarios Finales - RUBF, ownership threshold 10%); UIAF Circular 009 of 2022 (SARLAFT system and enhanced due diligence benchmarks).

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Existence and Legal Representation of the foreign parent/shareholder (Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal) with certified company bylaws
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent company registry or Chamber of Commerce in shareholder's country of origin

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized Special Power of Attorney for incorporation, registry filings and RUBF disclosure (Poder Especial)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public in shareholder's country of origin

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified copies of passport or national identity document of every beneficial owner and legal representative
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Civil registry or consular authority of country of origin

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter and source-of-funds certificate covering each shareholder capital contribution
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Issuing financial institution of the shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or Consular Legalization if origin state is not a Hague member

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all UBOs, directors and legal representatives against: UIAF and Procuraduría PEP registry (Postulados y Reporte de Situaciones de PEP), OFAC SDN List, UN Security Council Resolution 1267/1373 consolidated list, EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, Colombian SISNE national sanctions list, and INTERPOL Red Notices. Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD) applies to PEPs, including foreign PEPs, with residual monitoring for five years after public office exit per Law 2195 of 2022. The VPN and digital encryption software business is classified Medium_Risk_Enhanced; each shareholder contribution must be supported by reliable source-of-funds documentation prior to capital registration.
ubo_and_aml_profiling.mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun: Colombia is a Hague Apostille Convention member since 2001 (Law 455 of 1998), so foreign corporate documents follow the apostille path, not full consular legalization, for most source states.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: RUES - Registro Único Empresarial y Social (www.rue.com.co), operated jointly by Confecámaras and the territorial Cámara de Comercio with jurisdiction over the projected registered office; direct filings available via each Cámara de Comercio's digital portal
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The corporate name must be registered in Latin-alphabet Spanish characters; foreign-language brand tokens are permitted only when transliterated into Latin characters and clearly distinguishable from existing marks; the designation 'S.A.S.' must appear in the name; accents are retained, spaces and special characters are normalized; identical or confusingly similar names held by the same or another Cámara de Comercio trigger automatic rejection under Código de Comercio article 78.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: no more than one token of official or state connotation without prior ministerial authorization
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon rejection, the applicant files a written administrative appeal (recurso de reposición and, alternatively, apelación) before the registering Cámara de Comercio within ten business days of notification, per Law 1437 of 2011 articles 74-76. The applicant may concurrently request a new homonymy search on a corrected name; a fresh 30-day reservation window opens on approval. Where rejection rests on registry collision, the applicant may obtain express written consent (autorización expresa) from the prior registrant or await the lapse of the conflicting reservation. Escalated appeals are resolved by the Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio (SIC).

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Accepted in practice: a business center, co-working space or managed commercial address may be declared as the registered office for Cámara de Comercio and tax registry purposes, provided a physical, verifiable address is stated and a domicile for service of process is maintained. P.O. boxes alone are impermissible. For a VPN and digital encryption software company, virtual office arrangements are contractually valid but trigger enhanced due diligence requests from banks and, under UIAF Circular 009 of 2022, require the address service agreement to be evidenced during KYC reviews.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low_To_Medium_Risk_15Percent: unannounced on-site inspections by DIAN, UIAF, or the Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio are uncommon for a standard S.A.S. SaaS entity but become probable (30-45%) within 12 months if RUBF disclosures show inconsistencies, foreign PEPs are involved, or banking SARLAFT alerts arise.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff: fixed registration right plus incorporation tax of 0.7% on subscribed capital (typical small-cap S.A.S., excluding capital tax above 30,000 USD)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Foreign shareholder notarization and apostille legalization bundle (power of attorney, corporate existence certificate, passport copies)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Notary and apostille authority of country of origin
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark: USD 10-60 per apostille plus notary fees

Registro Único de Beneficiarios Finales (RUBF) initial filing and legal representative designation

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark flat fee for Medium-Risk-Enhanced technology entity

Registered office / virtual commercial address service for 12 months

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory correction tariffs and administrative fees

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Ley 1258 de 2008 (Estatuto de la Sociedad por Acciones Simplificada), Arts. 1-31; supplementary application of Código de Comercio (Decreto 410 de 1971), Arts. 98, 110-117, 372; Ley 2069 de 2020 (Emprendimiento), Arts. 6-8; Decreto 1074 de 2015, Book II, Title I (registral norms); Resolución SIC/RUES operational protocols for the single-window online incorporation.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Cámara de Comercio del domicilio social (Bogotá D.C.: Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá) via the Registro Único Empresarial y Social (RUES) single-window portal; final oversight and certification supervision by Superintendencia de Sociedades.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Documento Privado de Constitución (private incorporation instrument) filed and registered electronically in the Registro Mercantil at the Cámara de Comercio; Escritura Pública No. [X] required only if real property is contributed (Art. 5, Ley 1258 de 2008).
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum capital; the subscribed capital may be nominal. Any subscribed cash capital must be fully paid within two years (Art. 16, Ley 1258 de 2008); in-kind contributions must be identified on the incorporation instrument. No escrow account is mandated by commercial law; however, the Chamber of Commerce may verify capital proportionality against the corporate purpose, and banks require capital instalment evidence for account opening.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: FIRST BOARD RESOLUTION OF [COMPANY NAME] S.A.S. — The sole shareholder, having subscribed the entire capital stock of COP 10,000,000 (10,000 ordinary shares of COP 1,000 each), RESOLVES: (1) to ratify the share subscriptions and respective payment terms in accordance with Article 16 of Law 1258 of 2008; (2) to fix the registered office at Carrera 7 No. 71-21, Torre A, Oficina 901, Bogotá D.C. and to proceed with registration before the Cámara de Comercio; (3) to appoint [Name] as Principal Legal Representative and [Name] as Substitute; (4) to authorize the Legal Representative to open corporate bank and payment-processing accounts (Stripe, Paymentwall), sign the RUT with the DIAN, and apply for all non-statutory operating permits. Thus decided, no further business.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Pre-registration name availability certification (Certificado de Homonimia / Similitud)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio del domicilio social — RUES online platform (www.rues.org.co)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File through the RUES 'consulta de homonimia' module submitting up to three proposed corporate denominations with the mandatory 'S.A.S.' suffix; the Chamber validates absence of identical or confusingly similar names. In the online single-window 'Empresa en un día' process, the name check is integrated and the certificate of availability is generated automatically upon validation.
required_dossiers: Identity document of the requesting founder (Cédula de Ciudadanía or Passport)
Proposed corporate denomination with S.A.S. suffix (up to 3 alternatives)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a similar or identical name is detected, the applicant may file a written reconsideration with the Chamber within 5 business days, or simply resubmit an alternative denomination; the denial is not appealable in the registral phase and substitution is the standard procedural cure.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution and notarization of the incorporation instrument (Documento Privado de Constitución / Escritura Pública)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notary Public of the domicile (for real-property contributions); self-execution via electronic signature through the RUES single-window portal for standard private documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the estatutos containing the mandatory clauses: corporate name, registered office, corporate purpose (including VPN, encryption software, SaaS development and commercialization), subscribed and paid-in capital, classes and rights of shares, term, governance rules, legal representation, resolution of disputes, and liquidation rules. All founders must sign the private document or validly subscribe through the certified electronic signature; if the document contains contribution of real property, it must be granted by Escritura Pública before a Notary.
required_dossiers: Bylaws draft (Documento Privado de Constitución)
Identity documents of all founding shareholders
RUT pre-registration of the company (if already assigned)
Bank receipt or deposit certificate evidencing paid-in capital (unless deferred)
Data and identity of the Principal and Substitute Legal Representatives
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Notary or the Chamber objects to any clause (e.g., unlawful corporate purpose or defective capital schedule), amend the bylaws by a quorate shareholders' decision and re-file the corrected instrument; notarial refusal may be cured by converting to a private document when real-property contribution is the sole impediment.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Merchant registration and incorporation filing (Registro Mercantil, Matrícula Mercantil and pre-certificate of existence and representation)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio del domicilio social via RUES single-window portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the incorporation document and the 'Solicitud de Matrícula Mercantil' through RUES; pay the registration tariff calculated on the subscribed capital ceiling (approximate USD 160 all-inclusive). Upon approval, the Chamber registers the company, opens its folio in the Registro Mercantil, and issues the pre-certificate ('Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal') which carries the provisional NIT data and enables subsequent DIAN registration.
required_dossiers: Incorporation instrument (private document or public deed)
Name availability certificate (Certificado de Homonimia)
Proof of payment of the registration tariff
Identity and electronic mail of all shareholders and legal representatives
Accepted office declarations (Aceptación de cargos) of legal representatives
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Chamber records the application as 'pre-registrado' pending correction, the applicant has 5 business days to cure omissions through the RUES file; a formal refusal can be cured by re-filing with substituted lawful clauses; contested denials may be elevated to the Superintendencia de Sociedades for administrative review within the applicable statutory period.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax registration with DIAN — RUT update, definitive NIT assignment and electronic signature issuance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN) — Sede Electrónica (online tax portal)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon receipt of the Chamber pre-certificate, file the RUT 'actualización' form electronically at the DIAN virtual office to register the new company as an existing national entity; select the corporate income liability, IVA responsibility (if applicable), withholding and industry code CIIU 6201 (computer programming). Concurrently apply for the 'Firma Electrónica' certificate to enable e-invoicing and document-signing obligations (Resolución DIAN 165 de 2023).
required_dossiers: Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal (pre-certificate issued by the Chamber)
Incorporation instrument (Documento Privado de Constitución)
Identity document of the legal representative
Electronic mail and fiscal domicile proof
RUT application form (electronic Form 2612)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If DIAN issues an inconsistency notice regarding fiscal domicile or tax responsibilities, submit an electronic corrective RUT within 4 months; adversely resolved contradictory proceedings may be challenged through the 'devolución y corrección' administrative process in the Sede Electrónica.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Corporate governance formalities, statutory books and corporate bank account activation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio (sealing/registration of statutory books where applicable); commercial banks and SIC AML/KYC oversight for beneficial-owner verification
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Hold and minute the first board session adopting the pro-forma First Board Resolution (share subscription ratification, registered office, officer appointments, bank and payment-rail authorizations). Register or digitally seal the shareholders' register and minute books as recommended; open the corporate bank account and the Stripe/Paymentwall merchant accounts using the pre-certificate and final RUT; file the AML/KYC forms with final beneficial-owner declarations (SARLAFT, FATCA, CRS).
required_dossiers: Act of the First Board Session (pro-forma resolution minutes)
Pre-certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal
Final RUT with definitive NIT
Draft shareholders' register (libro de registro de accionistas)
AML/KYC and beneficial-owner declaration forms (SARLAFT, FATCA, CRS)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank rejects or delays the account due to the Medium-Risk enhanced AML classification of a VPN network-security SaaS, provide the certified corporate record, a definitive business plan evidencing lawful encryption software activities, and attend the enhanced due-diligence interview; a refusal may be cured by re-applying at a compliance-tolerant bank or by complaint to the Defensor del Consumidor Financiero.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Ministry of Information and Communication Technologies (MinTIC) — Dirección de Industria de Comunicaciones; Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio (SIC) for data-protection and consumer-law registration; Cuerpo Oficial de Bomberos and local Alcaldía for physical workplace clearances
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Exempt — pure software/VPN privacy application qualifies as an over-the-top (OTT) value-added software service outside the scope of the Colombian telecommunications concession/permits (Ley 1978 de 2019; Resolución MinTIC 3066 de 2022, Art. 2.1). No telecom operating license or MinTIC network-provider registration is required; only the mandatory corporate registration, RUT, and the Registro Nacional de Bases de Datos before SIC (Ley 1581 de 2012) apply to the data-processing activity.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Secretaría Distrital de Ambiente (Bogotá D.C.) / Autoridad Nacional de Licencias Ambientales (ANLA) for national-level guidance; Corporación Autónoma Regional (CAR) for the Cundinamarca region where applicable
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category IV — 'No EIA Required' (Exempt): pure office and software-development activity with no industrial process, no combustion equipment, no hazardous waste streams, and below the license thresholds of Decreto 1076 de 2015 (Art. 2.2.2.3.2.2); no environmental license or environmental impact study is due.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No process wastewater, VOCs, or noise-generating equipment attributable to software coding; office wastewater discharges to the public sewer must comply with the general allowable limits of Resolución 631 de 2015 (MADS); e-waste (computer equipment, batteries, peripherals) must be handed to authorized managers under Resolución 1512 de 2010 and Decreto 284 de 2018 (WEEE regime); solid waste handling must satisfy Ley 1259 de 2008 (comparendo ambiental) and local recycling mandates.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire-safety certification: obtain the 'Certificado de Seguridad Humana' / 'Conformidad de bomberos' issued by the Cuerpo Oficial de Bomberos of Bogotá D.C. before commencing physical office operations. Occupational clearance: implement the Sistema de Gestión de Seguridad y Salud en el Trabajo (SG-SST) per Decreto 1072 de 2015, register the employer under an ARL (Riesgos Laborales) within five days of first hiring, and constitute the COPASST (joint health-and-safety committee) upon exceeding five workers. Structural clearance: obtain the 'Certificado de Uso de Suelo' from the local Alcaldía; a formal structural load inspection is triggered only when the building-use classification changes to office/commercial Category 2 or when floors are altered under the Modelo de Referencia de Sismorresistencia (Reglamento NSR-10).

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN), via the electronic portal at www.dian.gov.co
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign-resident shareholder of a Colombian S.A.S. must first incorporate the S.A.S. under Law 1258/2008 before a notary and register with the local Chamber of Commerce. The S.A.S. must then register in the Registro Único Tributario (RUT) through DIAN's sede electrónica before commencing business, to obtain the Número de Identificación Tributaria (NIT). A local legal representative or tax attorney must be appointed with a notarized and apostilled power of attorney. Supporting incorporation and identity documents must be apostilled (or legalized) and translated into Spanish by a certified translator. Once the RUT is issued, the NIT is granted automatically and is used for all tax, VAT, and customs interactions.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation — the S.A.S. is a resident corporate taxpayer taxable on worldwide income, without pass-through eligibility. The corporate income tax rate is 35% at the base level, with an additional surtax for certain activities.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Domestic law does not provide check-the-box or hybrid mismatch elections for an S.A.S. The entity is classified objectively under Colombian tax law (Articles 22 and 12 of the Tax Code). No pass-through election or hybrid entity election is available. Mixed contracts may, however, adopt the Anticipated Transfer Pricing Agreement or the special stabilization regime for certain industries, but these are not classification elections.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: There is no turnover threshold for an S.A.S.; the entity must register as an IVA responsible person immediately upon carrying out any taxable commercial or service activity. By way of context, the simplified-regime threshold for individuals is 3,500 UVT (approximately COP 169 million for 2024), but that regime is not available to a legal entity. Therefore, the economically relevant trigger for an S.A.S. is the first peso of taxable operation.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: All S.A.S. legal entities are subject to compulsory electronic invoicing (Facturación Electrónica). Invoices must be generated, transmitted, and validated by DIAN through certified software or DIAN's free electronic solution. Real-time validation applies through DIAN's web-services/API; each invoice must bear the CUFE code and a QR digital stamp. The 'Documento Soporte en Operaciones con Proveedores del Exterior' is required to support cross-border payments for imported digital services. Periodic aggregation and final validation are mandatory; no offline invoice is permitted except under statutorily exempt remote coverage rules.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: To claim the 0% export VAT rate for digital/VPN services, the S.A.S. must prove that the service is provided to a non-resident client for the client's effective use or exploitation outside Colombian territory, and that the economic consideration is received from abroad. The service must be registered in the RUT as an export activity; the export contract and commercial invoice must identify the foreign beneficiary; and the service must be paid in foreign currency through the Colombian foreign exchange market, unless a specific exception applies. The VPN/Network Privacy SaaS must demonstrate a technical delivery outside Colombia, typically via offshore servers, logs, and supporting network diagrams. For physical goods, the goods must leave Colombian customs territory and be directly sold to a foreign purchaser.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Declaración de Exportación) – mandatory for physical goods; not required for pure digital VPN/software services
Bill of Lading, Airway Bill, or equivalent transport document – for physical goods only
Inward Remittance Certificate (Certificado de Ingreso de Divisas) or bank letter confirming receipt via the Colombian FX market
Export service contract and commercial invoice specifying the non-resident customer and place of effective use outside Colombia
DIAN-validated electronic sales invoice (FE) reflecting the 0% IVA rate
Documento Soporte en Operaciones con Proveedores del Exterior (when services are settled through compensations or covering foreign disbursements)
Certificate of compliance with the seven-year document retention obligation for export records
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: DIAN may conduct special audit reviews of export zero-rating claims for up to five years after the involved tax period. Fraudulent or unfounded zero-rating claims are subject to a 200% inaccuracy penalty on the omitted tax, plus default interest at 2% per month, and retrospective clawback of all VAT credits previously recognized on the export transactions. Carryover VAT declarations are barred until the export documentation is perfected. Criminal prosecution under Articles 402–405 of Law 599/2000 applies to willful fraudulent export claims; penalties include up to five years imprisonment and cancellation or permanent suspension of the exporter's NIT/RUT registry status.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banco de la República (Central Bank of Colombia) and the Comisión de Cambios (Foreign Exchange Commission). Operational supervision is exercised by the Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia (SFC). The binding regulatory framework is contained in Decree-Law 1068 of 2015, Circular Reglamentaria Externa DCIN-83 issued by Banco de la República, and the UIAF Anti-Money-Laundering Regulations.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Colombia operates a managed float convertibility system with full but heavily compliance-gated convertibility. Both current-account and capital-account transactions may generally be converted into Colombian pesos, but every foreign-exchange operation must be channelled through an authorized foreign-exchange intermediary (an IMC, typically a Tier-1 commercial bank). Foreign direct investment (FDI) into a Colombian S.A.S. must be registered with Banco de la República before capital repatriation or dividend remittance becomes lawful. Profit remittance is permitted, but access to the official foreign-exchange market requires proof of: (i) registration of the original inbound investment; (ii) payment of all Colombian income and dividend withholding taxes; (iii) a valid tax-existence certificate (e.g., NIT status and RUT); and (iv) compliance with enhanced AML/KYC source-of-funds checks. There are no direct quantitative controls on daily conversion, but unreasonable gap between receipt of foreign currency and conversion may be flagged under money-laundering typologies.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: All export proceeds generated by Colombian-based software and VPN services must be repatriated through the organized foreign-exchange market (

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Commercial Registry Renewal (Renovación de la Matrícula Mercantil)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Cámara de Comercio (local Chamber of Commerce)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before March 31 of each year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late fee up to COP 300,000 (approx. USD 75); administrative suspension of the registration after two consecutive unfiled renewals

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Income Tax Return (Declaración de Renta y Complementarios - Form 110)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: DIAN (Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Between March 15 and May 20 annually, according to the last two digits of the NIT (DIAN calendar)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Penalty of 5% of the income tax due for each full or partial month of delay, capped at 100% of tax; morph-over interest; potential freeze of bank accounts and NIT suspension

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Financial Statements Filing (Estados Financieros con destinación para la matrícula mercantil)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Cámara de Comercio (local Chamber of Commerce)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: No later than March 31 of the following fiscal year, or within 15 days after shareholder approval, whichever comes first
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fines up to 100 UVT; inability to renew commercial registration; administrative restrictions on business operations

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Final Beneficiary Declaration (Declaración de Beneficiario Final)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: DIAN (Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before June 30 of each year, or as set by DIAN resolution (aligned with income tax return calendar)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fine up to 200 UVT (approx. USD 2,500) for late filing; greater penalty for inaccurate or false information

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory independent audit for SAS if total assets exceed 5,000 SMMLV (approx. USD 1.7M) or gross revenue exceeds 10,000 SMMLV (approx. USD 3.4M) at fiscal year-end; also required for entities performing activities of public interest
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: IFRS as adopted in Colombia (NIIF margin) – Grupo 1 for large entities, Grupo 2 (NIIF para PYMES) for smaller SAS

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Annually, the SAS must submit via DIAN's electronic portal the list of final beneficiaries (any individual with direct or indirect ownership of 5% or more, or who exercises control). Share transfers must be reported as part of the declaration, and the registry is updated on the same schedule.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Libro de Actas de Asamblea de Accionistas (Minute Book)
Registro de Beneficiario Final (if not electronically filed, physical copy retained)
